svg.text: CVA6 Modified Instruction Compulsory Re-fetch & Execution Waveform (Cycles 610 – 625)
Following FENCE.I tag flush, subroutine call at 0x8000_0200 misses in I-Cache, triggers fresh AXI reload, fetches modified opcode 0x3e700513, and writes a0 = 999 at Cyc 621.

• Cyc 613: JALR at 0x8000_0048 commits, branching to 0x8000_0200. Because FENCE.I invalidated tags, I-Cache encounters compulsory miss (IcacheMiss=1). • Cyc 614–618: Core triggers AXI burst reload to 0x8000_0200, fetching the rewritten instruction (addi a0, 999). At Cyc 621, addi commits and writes 999 into GPR x10!
